Perform a security audit of the codebase, identifying potential vulnerabilities and suggesting improvements.

Output a detailed report highlighting security risks, potential exploits, and recommended fixes in a formatted table with the following columns: "Risk", "Description", "Potential Exploit", and "Recommended Fix","File Path". 

Ensure that the report is comprehensive and covers all critical areas of the codebase, including dependencies, configuration files, and custom code.
